Then in the same expression, we format. That's fine because the string lives during the call. But the test intends: create a long name (1000 chars) that does not match the format string "{name}". The fmt::arg gets the long name pointer. Then format string uses "name", which won't match, so it should throw. This works.

But we must fix only compilation errors. Also maybe include <string> already. So just change fmt::arg(long_name, 123) to fmt::arg(long_name.c_str(), 123). But the error message says no matching function for 'arg(std::string&, int)'. So fix that.
